subject: Warp glitch
text: Stepping up on the bridge leading to the town of Wendel, pressing select while moving before landing, saving, and resetting warps the player to Jadd upon reaching the boundary of the screen.

evidence.quote:
Warp ?- In the bridge that leads to the town of Wendel, do this: 1.
step one up 2. While moving, and before landing onto the next step
press "select" 3. Save, reset And you'll warp to Jadd after reaching
the boundary of the screen.
